text:
The Greens are fighting Labor’s NDIS razor gang. Join thousands of Australians speaking up for disability rights.

By signing this, you agree to be added to our mailing list to hear more about this campaign.

The Labor Government is planning to cut $36 billion from the NDIS, removing support from 160,000 people while increasing defence spending on weapons and submarines.

Cutting the NDIS isn't just cruel – it's bad economics.

Evidence shows that every dollar invested in the NDIS returns $2.25 to the economy1 – because getting the right support means more disabled people can work, increase their hours, and rely less on other supports over time.2

The NDIS isn’t a cost to cut. Investing in disabled people strengthens the entire economy.

When Labor cuts NDIS funding, they remove critical supports and force essential care work back onto families. This responsibility falls disproportionately on women, pushing carers out of the workforce right in the middle of a cost of living crisis.

Importantly, and most dangerously, not every disabled person has family to provide unpaid care.

We must fight back against Labor’s razor gang and protect the NDIS from cuts to ensure it holds strong for generations of disabled people to come.

That's why the Greens are fighting for an NDIS that is:

Disabled people are used to fighting for their basic rights, and the Greens will back their fight every step of the way.

Together we have protected our NDIS countless times. Join our campaign to tell Labor: No NDIS Cuts.

JOIN THE CAMPAIGN

1 Per Capita’s False Economy Report, November 2021
2 E61’s ‘Work, Welfare, And Wellbeing Around Entry Into The NDIS,’ March 2026
